## What's new

**Every vault gets a use.** Until now every cloud drive was tuned for streaming films. Now you choose for each vault what you use it for, and its drive reads, caches and uploads to match.

### Windows

- **New on every cloud vault's page: What you use this vault for.**
  - *Films and large files*: the values every drive has used so far. Stays the default, so nothing changes for your vaults unless you choose otherwise.
  - *Mixed*: a bit of everything, photos, music, documents and a film now and then.
  - *Documents and small files*: fetches little ahead, waits for the last save before uploading, and keeps used files on the PC for a week so that they open at once.
  - *Own values*: set every value yourself. Under each field you see what it does and what every profile recommends.
- **New on the Settings tab: Memory.** The memory buffer per open file, for all drives together. 128M for films, 32M is enough for documents or on a PC with 8 GB of memory or less.
- A new use counts from the next time the drive is connected. Vaults on this PC or a USB drive read straight from the disk and have no use.
- See [What a vault is used for](https://github.com/burnersen/CryptBridge/blob/main/docs/windows-app.md#what-a-vault-is-used-for).
- Your settings, vaults and the app lock stay as they are. rclone stays at 1.75.2.

### Linux server

- The warning about other programs on ports 80 and 443 now names the ports correctly on Debian and Ubuntu. Updating the server is not needed.

## Updating

- **Windows:** quit CryptBridge (wait until no uploads are running), replace `CryptBridge.exe` with the new one and start it. Going back to 0.12 later is possible: every vault then uses the film values again, and the chosen uses are forgotten once 0.12 saves its settings.
- **Server:** nothing to do.

## Downloads

- `CryptBridge.exe`: Windows 11 (64-bit), needs [WinFsp](https://winfsp.dev/rel/)
- `setup.sh`: Linux server (Ubuntu / Debian)
- Backup copies (optional, see above): the four rclone ZIP files, `winfsp-2.1.25156.msi`, `rclone-LICENSE.txt`, `WinFsp-LICENSE.txt`
